scope: Targeted Jazzy rebuild of the patched EGO planner package; this does not replace the existing 16-package workspace build or establish flight behavior.

source.behavior: Manual waypoint callbacks coalesce to the latest pending target. The FSM timer consumes it from WAIT_TARGET or EXEC_TRAJ, avoiding nested spin_some from a callback already serviced by the executor. Pending targets are discarded while EMERGENCY_STOP is active.
